findings.task: EP-SEC-001 M1: re-evaluate when upstream ships a compatible fix; re-triage before dueAt
findings.rationale: Lint toolchain only (devDependency). minimatch receives glob patterns from the repository ESLint config, never from users or network input; nothing reaches WEB artifacts. No compatible upstream release fixes minimatch yet (npm reports no fix / only a downgrade).

findings.task: EP-SEC-001 M1: re-evaluate when upstream ships a compatible fix; re-triage before dueAt
findings.rationale: Build-time service-worker generation (vite-plugin-pwa -> workbox-build). Inputs are the repository build config and dist/ file list; the generated service worker does not include these modules. The npm fix is a semver-major downgrade of vite-plugin-pwa, so it is tracked instead of forced.
